description: This file defines a Java interface 'ThingSearchCommand' in the package 'org.eclipse.ditto.signals.commands.thingsearch'. It specifies common behaviors and properties for commands related to the 'thing search' functionality within the Eclipse Ditto project, including methods for retrieving command-specific metadata and parameters.

classes.name: ThingSearchCommand
classes.description: A generic interface for 'thing search' commands, providing methods for retrieving command metadata and parameters such as selected fields, namespaces, command type prefix, resource path, resource type, and setting Ditto headers.

methods.name: getSelectedFields
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the JsonFieldSelector specifying fields to include in the search result, or empty if none specified.

methods.name: getNamespaces
methods.description: Returns an Optional set of namespace strings associated with the command, or empty if none are specified.

methods.name: getTypePrefix
methods.description: Returns the prefix used to identify the command type, combining 'thing-search.' with a type qualifier.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Provides the JSON pointer path for the resource, defaulting to an empty path.

methods.name: getResourceType
methods.description: Returns the entity type string associated with thing search, obtained from configurations.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Sets the Ditto headers for the command, enabling modification of header metadata.
